prompt:
Original Taiwanese game art for "Tainan Gazetteer" (府城夜巡地圖), set in Tainan around 1930.
Style: handmade layered paper sculpture (紙雕 / kirie), the same for buildings, trees, plants,
fences, ground tiles, icons and props. Every shape is a piece of cut paper: visible paper fibres,
slightly soft hand-cut edges, pieces overlapping in shallow layers with small soft contact shadows
where one sheet sits on another. Colour is printed on the paper: clearly visible risograph /
stencil print grain and uneven ink density across every flat area, never a clean digital fill.
Weathering is welcome: irregular faded patches, not neat squares.
Details are built from few, large cut pieces (roof tiles, bricks, window frames, leaves, petals,
stones, planks), not painted lines and not crowded tiny patterns. Plants are natural and
asymmetric.
Colour: follow the real object, then mute it: pale, slightly greyed, warm. Typical tones: warm
cream, pale brick red, coral, sage and grey-green, mustard, indigo, wood brown, stone grey.
No saturated red-against-green contrast.
Buildings: strictly frontal elevation, no perspective, three or four flat paper layers.
Do NOT make: a 3D render or clay/plastic model, smooth bevelled relief, realistic or painterly
illustration, photo textures, thick foam layers, glow, glossy highlights, black outline strokes,
smooth gradients, depth of field.
Output: generated natively on a fully TRANSPARENT background (real alpha including enclosed
holes, no backdrop, no glow, no chroma-key colour, no coloured fringe), every object complete
and separated by clear transparent gutters, no ground, no base, no cast shadow outside the
object, no text, no captions, no logos.

Create a single full-tree Taiwanese royal poinciana (Delonix regia) game sprite, around 780 pixels tall for a 130-unit tree. Use a 1536 by 1024 landscape canvas with deliberately generous TRANSPARENT padding. The tree itself must fit a central 1200 by 780 pixel bounding rectangle, leaving about 122 pixels of empty alpha above the highest flower and below the roots, and at least 155 pixels on each side. Draw the paper grain at this intended native size. Blend the five supplied project references by role. Images 1–2 (P9, P12) set the foliage and blossom design: conspicuous cut-paper pinnate sprays, each with a clear central axis and two rows of large rounded leaflets, running around the perimeter of the foliage masses. Large recognizable orange-red five-petal flowers with simple warm-yellow stamens, a little paler and warmer than the early examples. Set the flowers in only a few bold groups of three or five at the top edges of the foliage, with mostly foliage elsewhere.
Images 3–4 set the wide umbrella silhouette and horizontally spreading primary branches. Image 5 sets the trunk construction: use only the cherry and maple in its bottom row as references for the strongly bent, sharply angular paper trunk with differently tapered segments, oblique side forks and overlapping flat planes of warm grey-brown paper. Avoid rounded tubing, braided or twisted trunk ribbons. Use three unequal coherent foliage masses made from broad rounded paper layers under the clear pinnate sprays. Ikebana composition with an irregular triangle, purposeful gaps through to fully transparent background, visible wood between crowns, no even spacing. Place the largest mass high and slightly left of center, the medium mass out on the longer right limb, and the small mass low on the left. Leave broad tapered openings on both sides of the central fork.
Keep clean opaque cut-paper surfaces and crisp antialiased alpha only at cut edges. Every negative-space opening is clear alpha. No fog, glow, halo, atmospheric shading, border, ground patch, edge spill or external drop shadow. The composition references are for shape only; ignore all of their background lighting or halos.
Keep the three outer clusters individually readable and expose the hard switchback of the primary trunk. The clear padding and the openings between the foliage masses must be absolutely empty alpha, without even a faint semitransparent mist.
notes: 內建 ImageGen 單張生成四版，全部保留原生 alpha。主圖採 candidate-4.png，三團高低錯落，枝間留白最清楚，折紙樹幹轉折分明。主圖直接複製原始生成檔，畫布 1536×1024 px，alpha ≥128 的樹身約 906 px 高，高於約 780 px 的目標。依 Art Bible 10a 保留原生紙紋尺度。實景照片參考：環境資訊中心〈台南5月賞花記〉 https://e-info.org.tw/node/8439 （臺南行道樹傘形與花色）；國立興大附農森林科〈鳳凰木〉 https://www.tcavs.tc.edu.tw/forestry/7-2.asp?proid=20180828142651&trarea=3 （冠幅與枝條）；維基共享資源嘉義北門車站鳳凰木照片 https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Delonix_regia_(Taiwan).jpg （花與羽狀葉）。工具每張最多五個影像參考，各版輪替早期圖兩張，整批涵蓋四張。
